22672.d: Saradomin's Encampment is the encampment of Saradomin in the south-east of God Wars Dungeon.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Saradomin's Encampment is located in the south-eastern section of the dungeon, which can be accessed by the Agility shortcut leading to the encampment.

Travel methods include:
• Any travelling methods getting to the dungeon
• Boss portal at War's retreat - Requires killing Commander Zilyana at least once
• Boss portal at Max Guild - Requires Max cape and killing Commander Zilyana at least once

22749.d: The sawmills are a type of workbench that can be found inside of the Workshop in Fort Forinthry and in Rimmington.

22750.d: The Sawmill was a small complex along the south-east wall of the Lumber Yard, located north-east of Varrock.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Lumber Yard Teleport
• Wicked hood teleport to the earth altar
• Earth altar teleport
• Balloon transport system
• Invitation box to the Empyrean Citadel, then again to Silvarea, then run west
• Infernal Source by using the Master archaeologist's outfit or teleport using Archaeology journal to use the Dig sites map, then run east.
• Skeletal horror Teleport

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Sawmill Co. - A 'G.H.A' Subsidiary'

22752.d: A sawmill operator can be found within the Ithell district of Prifddinas, marked by the icon on the minimap.
22752.ex: She changes the shape of wood.

22753.d: Sawmill training was a members-only Woodcutting training method.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Lumber Yard Teleport
• Balloon transport system puts the player just south of the sawmill
• Archaeology journal teleport, then run north
• Walk from Varrock
• Dig Site pendant teleport to the Varrock Dig Site, then run north-west
• Gnome glider destination 3. Lemanto Andra, then run north
• Earth altar teleport or wicked hood teleport to the earth altar, then run north
• Invitation box, used twice puts the player in Silvarea, then run west

22772.d: The Scabarite Cavern is located underground in the Kharidian Desert, north-west of Pollnivneach.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Pollnivneach Teleport scroll takes user directly to Pollnivneach
• Using the Magic carpet network to "North Pollnivneach"
• House Teleport, if players can use the house portal in Pollnivneach, they can use the spell to reach their house and then exit through the portal
• Wear the master constructor's outfit and use it to teleport to the house portal (regardless of which house portal their house is located at)
• Pollnivneach tablet, if the Love Story quest has been completed
• Ring of slaying, Slayer cape or Slayer master cape, teleport to the house of slayer master Sumona
• The Mask of Mourning and Helm of Keening can teleport user to the Pollnivneach well
• The master camouflage outfit offers unlimited teleports to Pollnivneach, just north-east of the well
• Walking south/south-east from the Shantay Pass.

22794.d: ScapeRune is a realm parallel to Gielinor, which formerly housed the Evil Bob's and Prison Pete's random events.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Players may visit and leave the island any time through fairy ring code CIS.

Before the random events were removed, players were accosted by Evil Bob, the evil twin of Bob (cat) the Jagex Cat. With a RSChat | Meow from Evil Bob and a RSChat | No... what? Nooooooooooooo! from the player, they would arrive at Evil Bob's island. If the player shouted RSChat | Aaaarrrrgh! instead, they would arrive in a prison.
